normalized: upstream body with a HivemindOS multi-provider routing preface; folded-scalar description flattened to a single line for the HivemindOS catalog parser
description: Use for a concrete request to create, render, or deliver a video when the user chooses HyperFrames (including the common shorthand or typo hypergen), HTML-based video, browser-rendered video, or motion graphics, and use as the HivemindOS method router when a concrete video-creation request leaves the production method open. Distinguish actionable creation from discussion, brainstorming, hypotheticals, and capability questions; those should not trigger generation or a method question.
hivemindAdaptations: Auto-installs only the HyperFrames entry/router skill. The domain skills (hyperframes-core, -animation, -cli, -registry, -creative, -media, media-use) and the workflow skills (product-launch-video, website-to-video, faceless-explainer, pr-to-video, embedded-captions, talking-head-recut, motion-graphics, music-to-video, slideshow, general-video, remotion-to-hyperframes) install on demand and are NOT vendored.

Adds a HivemindOS semantic routing boundary: agents distinguish actionable creation from ordinary video discussion, recognize HyperFrames and the common shorthand/typo hypergen, and ask about cloud AI, local AI, or HTML / HyperFrames only when a concrete creation request leaves the method open; the rendering workflow owns only the HTML / HyperFrames branch.
Install the full toolchain on demand with `npx hyperframes init` or `npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes --all`; a single workflow with `npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes --skill <name>`.

The Apache-2.0 upstream body is preserved after a short HivemindOS multi-provider routing preface; the upstream folded YAML `description: >` scalar is replaced with a HivemindOS-aware single-line description and `metadata.tags` is dropped so the catalog parser surfaces it.
No upstream HyperFrames runtime, CLI, registry blocks, package code, or media assets are copied into this repository.
